# sendgrid_event_webhook (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid Event Webhook by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_event_webhook" "delivery_events" {
  id = "77d4a5da-7015-11ed-a1eb-0242ac120002"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The Event Webhook's ID.

### Read-Only

- `bounce` (Boolean) Receive bounce events.
- `click` (Boolean) Receive click events.
- `deferred` (Boolean) Receive deferred events.
- `delivered` (Boolean) Receive delivered events.
- `dropped` (Boolean) Receive dropped events.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this Event Webhook is enabled.
- `friendly_name` (String) The friendly name for this webhook.
- `group_resubscribe` (Boolean) Receive group resubscribe events.
- `group_unsubscribe` (Boolean) Receive group unsubscribe events.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) OAuth client ID configured for this webhook.
- `oauth_token_url` (String) OAuth token URL configured for this webhook.
- `open` (Boolean) Receive open events.
- `processed` (Boolean) Receive processed events.
- `public_key` (String) The public key used to verify request signatures, if signed.
- `signed` (Boolean) Whether signature verification is enabled.
- `spam_report` (Boolean) Receive spam report events.
- `unsubscribe` (Boolean) Receive unsubscribe events.
- `url` (String) The URL SendGrid POSTs event data to.
